hub.speaker: Market-Tier Local
hub.text: Busy morning for the stalls. Mind the queues — the one at my lamp table is out past the awning already.

text_variants.text: Don't see many of you up this tier. And now I'm staring. Sorry. It's not personal, you're just not a common sight up here.
You'll want the second queue — the first one's for out-of-towners. You know how it is.

text_variants._comment: v0.15 T4.1 market ambient reactivity. Ordered AFTER the race reads on purpose (last match wins): once the tier's own chain has moved, the region acknowledging it beats a first-meeting read. No shipped pallass fixture banks either counter, so every pinned canonical still lands on the base or race text.
text_variants.text: Forge-tier stamp on you. Then you've met our queues properly. The second window's the slow one, whatever the sign claims.
Word came up the shaft about Liscor and whatever sat under it. I sold three lamps off the strength of that story this morning, so I'll not complain.

options.text: Anything on you worth my coin?

options._comment: #513 Room on the Row. APPENDED LAST and requires-hidden on wool_trade_started, so every ungated reader still sees exactly [sell, Morning.] and trader_earn_loop/pallass_peek's row indices hold.
options.text: About the Gnoll with the wool.

row_wool.speaker: Market-Tier Local
row_wool.text: The counter's free. It stays free till I see her weights checked. Eight years back a trader sold this row short with a hollow weight, and I was paying off that season for two more.

options._comment: TALK route, Skill arm. Skill gates render visible-locked, so a player without it still sees the route exists.
options.text: [Charming Smile] Ask her to come and look at the brass herself.

options._comment: TALK route, Skill-free arm: arms the public scales' variants row.
options.text: Then check her weights at the public scales, in front of everyone.

row_scales.speaker: Market-Tier Local
row_scales.text: Fine. The city's weights are chained to the scales by the parapet. If her brass sits level with them in front of the row, I've nothing to say against it.

row_opened_smile.speaker: Market-Tier Local
row_opened_smile.text: Don't smile at me like that, I'm working. Fine. Counter three, posted rent, settled at week's end like everyone. I'll look at her brass when she sets up. I look at everyone's.

row_opened_scales.speaker: Market-Tier Local
row_opened_scales.text: Level, was it. Fine. Counter three, posted rent, settled at week's end like everyone. She brings the weights every morning, mind. I'll be looking.
